01 · The list

Every word,
in exam order

HSK 4 adds 598 new words, for a cumulative syllabus of about 1,200. At this level you discuss a fairly wide range of topics and read native texts with some help. Every entry shows the hanzi, pinyin with tone marks and an English meaning.

In Lock&Learn Chinese this list is the HSK 4 pack: a word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. HSK 4 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Type to filter by hanzi, pinyin or meaning. Flashcards hides the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

25 words,
each in a sentence

Every word in Lock&Learn Chinese comes with a real example sentence, its reading and a translation, revealed on the tap. Here are 25 from this list.

吃惊

chījīng

be startled

听到这个消息，大家都非常吃惊。

Tīng dào zhège xiāoxī, dàjiā dōu fēicháng chījīng.

Everyone was very startled when they heard this news.

地址

dìzhǐ

postal address

请把你的地址写在这张纸上。

Qǐng bǎ nǐ de dìzhǐ xiě zài zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng.

Please write your address on this piece of paper.

得意

déyì

pleased with oneself

他赢了比赛，显得十分得意。

Tā yíng le bǐsài, xiǎn de shí fēn dé yì.

He looked very pleased with himself after winning the competition.

翻译

fānyì

to translate or interpret

请帮我把这篇文章翻译成中文。

Qǐng bāng wǒ bǎ zhè piān wénzhāng fānyì chéng Zhōngwén.

Please help me translate this article into Chinese.

方面

fāngmiàn

aspect or field

他在很多方面都做得很好。

Tā zài hěnduō fāngmiàn dōu zuò de hěn hǎo.

He does very well in many aspects.

干燥

gānzào

dry or arid

北方春天的气候特别干燥。

Běifāng chūntiān de qìhòu tèbié gānzào.

The climate in the north is very dry in the spring.

观众

guānzhòng

audience or spectators

音乐会结束后，观众们都站起来鼓掌。

Yīnyuèhuì jiéshù hòu, guānzhòngmen dōu zhàn qǐlái gǔzhǎng.

After the concert ended, the audience stood up and applauded.

流行

liúxíng

popular or fashionable

这首歌在年轻人中非常流行。

Zhè shǒu gē zài niánqīngrén zhōng fēicháng liúxíng.

This song is very popular among young people.

密码

mìmǎ

password or code

请设置一个简单的手机开机密码。

Qǐng shèzhì yī gè jiǎndān de shǒujī kāijī mìmǎ.

Please set a simple password for your phone.

轻松

qīngsōng

relaxed or effortless

休息一会儿，心情就会变得轻松一些。

Xiūxi yīhuìr, xīnqíng jiù huì biàn de qīngsōng yīxiē.

If you rest for a while, your mood will become a bit more relaxed.

穷

qióng

poor or destitute

他年纪轻轻就因为穷而不得不离开家乡。

Tā niánjì qīngqīng jiù yīnwèi qióng ér bùdébù líkāi jiāxiāng.

He had to leave his hometown at a young age because he was poor.

群

qún

group crowd flock

公园里有一群人在做运动。

Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu yī qún rén zài zuò yùndòng.

There is a group of people exercising in the park.

社会

shèhuì

society

现代社会的生活节奏越来越快了。

Xiàndài shèhuì de shēnghuó jiézòu yuè lái yuè kuài le.

The pace of life in modern society is getting faster and faster.

申请

shēnqǐng

apply for something

我打算下个月向学校申请奖学金。

Wǒ dǎsuàn xià gè yuè xiàng xuéxiào shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn.

I plan to apply for a scholarship from the school next month.

十分

shífēn

very or extremely

今天的考试内容十分简单。

Jīntiān de kǎoshì nèiróng shífēn jiǎndān.

The content of today's exam was extremely simple.

试

shì

to try or test

你可以试一下这件衬衫，看看合不合适。

Nǐ kěyǐ shì yīxià zhè jiàn chènshān, kànkan hébùhéshì.

You can try on this shirt to see if it fits.

首都

shǒudū

capital city

北京是中国的首都。

Běijīng shì Zhōngguó de shǒudū.

Beijing is the capital city of China.

数量

shùliàng

amount or quantity

为了完成这个任务，我们需要统计物品的数量。

Wèile wánchéng zhège rènwù, wǒmen xūyào tǒngjì wùpǐn de shùliàng.

To complete this task, we need to count the quantity of the items.

数字

shùzì

number or digit

现在很多人的生活都离不开数字。

Xiànzài hěn duō rén de shēnghuó dōu lí bù kāi shùzì.

Nowadays, many people's lives cannot do without numbers.

污染

wūrǎn

to pollute

过度使用农药会导致严重的土地污染。

Guòdù shǐyòng nóngyào huì dǎozhì yánzhòng de tǔdì wūrǎn.

Excessive use of pesticides can lead to serious soil pollution.

无聊

wúliáo

bored or boring

外面一直在下雨，我觉得很无聊。

Yīnwèi wàimiàn yīzhí zài xiàyǔ, wǒ juéde hěn wúliáo.

Because it has been raining outside, I feel very bored.

详细

xiángxì

detailed

请告诉我国详细的计划。

Qǐng bǎ nǐ jìhuà de xiángxì nèiróng gàosù wǒ.

Please tell me your detailed plan.

效果

xiàoguǒ

result or effect

这种新药治疗效果很好。

Zhè zhǒng xīnyào zhìliáo xiàoguǒ hěn hǎo.

The effect of this new medicine is very good.

亚洲

Yàzhōu

Asia

亚洲是世界上最大的洲。

Yàzhōu shì shìjiè shàng zuì dà de zhōu.

Asia is the world's largest continent.

真正

zhēnzhèng

genuine or real

这是他第一次说出真正的心里话。

Zhè shì tā dì yī cì shuō chū zhēnzhèng de xīnlǐhuà.

This is the first time he has spoken his true feelings.

04 · Questions

Asked and
answered

How many words are in the HSK 4 vocabulary list?

598. The six-level HSK syllabus adds about 150, 150, 300, 600, 1,300 and 2,500 new words per level, about 5,000 in all; this page lists the words that are new at HSK 4, not the cumulative total.

Is this the official HSK HSK 4 word list?

It follows the official six-level HSK syllabus (HSK 2.0), the list the HSK 1 to 6 exams are still administered on. The HSK 3.0 standard published in 2021 reorganises vocabulary into nine bands and is not what this page shows.

How do I study the HSK 4 list on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Chinese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Chinese. The HSK 4 pack puts these words on the widget one at a time: you recall the meaning, one tap reveals it with a real sentence. HSK 4 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Can I download the HSK 4 vocabulary list as a PDF?

Yes. Use your browser's Print or Save as PDF: the page has a print layout that keeps only the heading and the full table, every word on this list.

Is Lock&Learn Chinese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: HSK 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
